newsitem.title: USA: Procter & Gamble to buy Grupo Carso tissue unit.
newsitem.headline: Procter & Gamble to buy Grupo Carso tissue unit.

text.p: Procter & Gamble Co said on Monday it reached an agreement in principle to buy Loreto y Pena Pobre, a tissue products company based in Mexico City, from Grupo Carso for $170 million.
The deal would give P&G Lypps, Pampys and other toilet tissue brands, and a manufacturing plant in Apizaco, Tlaxcala.
Other than this plant, all other facilities with the name Loreto y Pena Pobre would remain part of Grupo Carso.
Procter & Gamble also would acquire the Lunch and Cheff table napkin brands.
P&G already sells diapers and feminine protection pads in Mexico through its P&G de Mexico subsidiary. The Loreto y Pena Pobre acquisition would provide P&G's first tissue entry into Latin America.
